senses.g: If you are young, you have not lived a long time.
ex: She was only a young girl.
The young lion plays with his brothers and sisters.
He is very young.
They were friends from his young manhood.

senses.g: A young is an offspring of an animal.
ex: The lion caught a gnu to feed its young.
The lion's young are curious.

senses.g: The comparative form of young; more young.
The superlative form of young; most young.
ex: She is the youngest of the children.

senses.g: The quality or state of being young.
The part of life after childhood.
A young person.
Young people, as a group.
A youthful person is an older person who seems young.
ex: The young man was being very youthful.

senses.g: The plural form of youth; more than one (kind of) youth.
A zap is the sound made by a sudden release of electricity.
A zap is an electric shock.
If you zap someone or something, you strike it with electricity.
If you zap someone or something, you destroy it or kill them.
If someone has zeal, they work very hard at a certain goal.
ex: My brother is training with great zeal – he practices at every spare moment so that he can make the soccer team.
St. Paul spread Christianity with zeal after his conversion.

senses.g: An animal that somewhat looks like a horse, but has black and white stripes.
ex: We saw zebras while we were in Africa.

senses.g: By extension, any black and white stripe pattern that looks like a zebra.
ex: I want to paint the room with zebra stripes.

senses.g: The symbol for the number zero, that is "0."
ex: The new job added a zero to my pay, from $20,000 to $200,000.

senses.g: A person or thing that is worth nothing.
ex: I'm not inviting him, he's total zero.

senses.g: To zero is to make a small change to reset a piece of equipment.
ex: I had to zero the counter on my tape player.

senses.g: To zero in is to make small changes that bring you closer to something.
ex: I was able to zero in on the source of bad smell in the shed.

senses.g: The plural form of zero; more than one (kind of) zero.
Zinc is a type of metal, (symbol Zn) with an atomic number of 30 on the periodic table.
If you zinc something, you cover it with zinc.
A zip is a sound made by a small object.
ex: Zip!

senses.g: A zip is a short form of zipper.
ex: Is the zip on your coat working.

senses.g: If something zips somewhere, it move there quickly.
ex: The birds zip from tree to tree.

senses.g: If you zip something up, you close its zipper.
ex: Zip up your coat before going outside.

senses.g: A zone is an area that is known for a particular use.
ex: You are in a no-smoking zone.
Touchdowns are made in the end zone.

senses.g: When you are in the zone, you are in a time of high performance.
If you zone something, you divide into it; you give it a particular use.
If you zone a property, you determine what the property will be used for.
The plural form of zone; more than one (kind of) zone.
The third-person singular form of zone.
A zoo is a park that people go to where live animals can be seen.
ex: There are lions at our local zoo.

senses.g: To move fast.
To go up sharply.
To change the focus of a zoom lens
To increase suddenly.
The past tense and past participle of zoom.
A zygote is a fertilized egg cell.
